title: RICE-PO: Turning Retrieval Interactions into Credit Signals for Reasoning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.26352v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Retrieval is increasingly moving from one-shot matching toward interactive reasoning, where language agents iteratively inspect evidence, reformulate queries, and search again. Training such agents raises a credit-assignment challenge: executable actions such as queries or summaries can be directly evaluated by the retriever, while latent reasoning steps are not directly observable and only affect future executable actions. This asymmetry makes outcome-level reward assignment unreliable, as the same final reward may credit reasoning steps that did not actually shape retrieval success. We propose RICE-PO, a critic-free policy optimization framework that converts retrieval interactions into localized learning signals. translated_title: RICE-PO：将检索交互转化为推理智能体的信用信号
translated_abstract: 检索正日益从一次性匹配转向交互式推理，其中语言智能体迭代地检查证据、重新构造查询并再次搜索。训练此类智能体带来了信用分配方面的挑战：查询或摘要等可执行动作可以由检索器直接评估，而潜在的推理步骤却不可直接观察，只能通过影响未来的可执行动作来发挥作用。这种不对称性使得基于最终结果的奖励分配不可靠，因为相同的最终奖励可能会错误地归功于那些实际上并未促成检索成功的推理步骤。我们提出 RICE-PO，这是一个无评论家（critic-free）的策略优化框架，能够将检索交互转化为局部化的学习信号。RICE-PO 选择高不确定性的可执行动作作为锚点，利用检索指标评估局部反事实分支，并且仅在推理对动作的影响足够显著时，才将信用传播到潜在的推理步骤。
tldr: RICE-PO 是一个无评论家的策略优化框架，通过将高不确定性可执行动作作为锚点、评估局部反事实分支并将信用有条件地传播给潜在推理步骤，把检索交互转化为局部化信用信号，从而解决交互式推理检索智能体训练中的信用分配难题。
en_tdlr: RICE-PO is a critic-free policy optimization framework that turns retrieval interactions into localized credit signals by anchoring on high-uncertainty executable actions, evaluating counterfactual branches, and propagating credit to latent reasoning steps only when their influence is significant, addressing the credit-assignment challenge in training interactive reasoning retrieval agents.
